title: Financial Profile Authority Expansion

contracts.name: GetFinancialProfile
contracts.authorization: Owning service enforces trusted workload, actor, purpose, authorization and customer context.
contracts.provenance: Every returned fact carries a Financial Provenance reference.

contracts.name: NormalizeSourceFacts
contracts.input: Validated provider-neutral source facts with evidence and transformation references.
contracts.output: Created or revised authoritative financial facts.
contracts.stateSemantics: Owner-only atomic promotion with explicit revision and replay-safe effects.
contracts.authorization: Owning service enforces trusted workload, actor, purpose, authorization and customer context.
contracts.provenance: Evidence, document version, source fact, transformation, actor, workload, time and correlation lineage retained.

contracts.name: GetFinancialFact
contracts.output: One current authoritative provider-neutral financial fact.
contracts.stateSemantics: Read-only current revision; history is not destructively rewritten.
contracts.authorization: Owning service enforces trusted workload, actor, purpose, authorization and customer context.
contracts.provenance: The response carries its Financial Provenance reference.

contracts.name: GetFinancialProvenance
contracts.input: Authorized Financial Provenance and customer identifiers.
contracts.authorization: Owning service enforces trusted workload, actor, purpose, authorization and customer context.
contracts.provenance: Resolves evidence, source-fact, transformation, actor, workload, time and correlation lineage.

contracts.name: FinancialFactCreated
contracts.output: Immutable fact identity, type, revision and provenance reference.
contracts.stateSemantics: Already-committed fact; no mutable profile replication.
errorSemantics: Malformed or unsupported events are rejected without authoritative mutation.
contracts.authorization: Consumers authorize any current-detail query independently.

contracts.name: FinancialFactUpdated
contracts.output: Immutable fact identity, type, revision and provenance reference.
contracts.stateSemantics: Already-committed revision; prior fact and provenance history remain intact.
errorSemantics: Malformed or unsupported events are rejected without authoritative mutation.
contracts.authorization: Consumers authorize any current-detail query independently.
contracts.provenance: Carries new immutable Financial Provenance reference.

contracts.name: FinancialProfileChanged
contracts.output: Coarse immutable profile revision and changed fact identifiers.
contracts.stateSemantics: Prompts authorized current-state query; never replicates the profile.
errorSemantics: Malformed or unsupported events are rejected without authoritative mutation.
contracts.authorization: Consumers authorize any current-detail query independently.
contracts.provenance: Fact events carry lineage; this coarse notification carries identifiers only.

securityObligations: Server-side trusted actor, workload, purpose, authorization and customer-context validation.
No cross-customer reads or writes and no client-supplied ownership trust.
Safe errors and telemetry without sensitive financial values, evidence payloads, credentials or secrets.
provenanceObligations: Every source-derived authoritative fact links evidence, document version and source fact.
Extraction, validation and normalization versions remain immutable lineage.
Actor, workload, time, correlation and causation context remain traceable.
auditObligations: CID-034 and CID-035 propagate append-oriented identifier-only Audit evidence.
Audit remains independently owned and non-authoritative for Financial Profile state.
Duplicate event delivery is replay-safe without strengthening delivery guarantees.
exclusions: Financial Rules calculation or health-score methodology
physical database, ORM, schema or migration
physical messaging or operational durability claim
search, vector, AI, reporting pack or connector implementation
UAT, Production, package/image publication or deployment
